notes.title: Prologue Update
notes.notes: The Fights in Tight Spaces Prologue has been updated to fully reflect the state of the full game, with improved interactions, bug fixes, and up-to-date graphics.

notes.title: Fights in Tight Spaces - Full Game in Early Access Now!
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39215429/d79fd9642e33e4c377b6e404b2c04365871f852d.png[/img]

Thanks to all of you who have been playing the Prologue!

We really hope that you'll check out the full game which has [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1265820/Fights_in_Tight_Spaces/]just released into Early Access[/url].

All of your feedback and testing has been invaluable and Early Access will help us make the game as good as it can possibly be - there's a lot of tweaking and new content we want to introduce, but if you'd like to support us further then do pick it up and enjoy the other four levels above and beyond the Prologue.

notes.title: Early Access Update
notes.notes:
The Early Access version of Fights in Tight Spaces launches today.

The Prologue has been updated with all the latest changes and fixes from the full game.

notes.title: FITS: Prologue Update (February 8th)
notes.notes:
[u]Prologue Update[/u]

Thanks to everyone who has played the FITS Prologue. We've had some amazing feedback, and we really appreciate all your reviews and messages. In response to some of that, we've updated a few aspects of the game. Including the UI so enemy attacks and intents are a bit clearer, there's updated music, and less music repetition on long levels (and for those of you who like to take your time).

Biggest news is that the default replay system now shows you the whole fight, and there's a couple of other options to play with (some of which are work-in-progress, but we wanted to show the direction we were taking this area of the game in).

- New, clearer UI
- Updated music tracks
- New replay system!
- Events are a bit clearer and balanced a little more in the player's favour
- Lots of smaller fixes and updates

We've also announced that [b]FITS is coming to Steam Early Access on February 24th[/b], so if you haven't already wish listed the game, we'd love you to do so so you get notified the second that it is released.
